verdict.rationale: Alloy is a KYC/AML and fraud decisioning platform, so configurable name matching and alias or transliteration match inspection is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack only mentions watchlist updates and AML checks in general terms. Nothing documents configurable name-matching thresholds or algorithms, or any way to inspect alias or transliteration matches.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can configure name matching and inspect alias or transliteration matches
